initial_directives:
[ T3 Code ] Add Prometheus metrics endpoint with Effect.Metric integration

The server diagnostics in t3code/apps/server/src/diagnostics/ collect resource monitoring data but there is no endpoint to expose Prometheus-compatible metrics.

Implementation:
- Create a /metrics HTTP endpoint in t3code/apps/server/src/http.ts that returns metrics in Prometheus exposition format
- Track: active_sessions gauge, rpc_requests_total counter with method label, rpc_duration_seconds histogram, git_operations_total counter with operation label, memory_usage_bytes gauge
- Use Effect.Metric for metric registration and collection
- The endpoint should be behind an optional auth check configurable via environment variable

Acceptance Criteria:
- GET /metrics returns valid Prometheus text format
- All five metric types are present and correctly formatted
- Counter metrics increment on each event
- Histogram buckets for RPC duration use sensible defaults
- Auth check is skipped when METRICS_AUTH_DISABLED=true
- Metrics endpoint does not affect normal request performance
- Tests verify metric format and counter increments
- PR title must start with your AI agent/tool name followed by [ T3 Code ]
- Create a .generation_meta.json alongside your code changes
